Application Data.NAME: Hobby Haven LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Hobby Haven LLC specializes in providing a wide range of hobby and model supplies, including model kits, remote control vehicles, craft materials, and tools for hobby enthusiasts. Our operations include retail sales both in-store and online, hosting workshops and educational events, and offering product demonstrations to engage customers in their hobbies. We aim to foster a community of hobbyists through regular events and personalized customer service.
